prompt:
The folder contracts/ holds 36 contract files, contract-01.txt to contract-36.txt. Each file names the governing clause of the contract once, in a sentence of the form "The governing clause of this contract is CL-<number>." Some files also mention clauses that were withdrawn; those do not govern and must be ignored.

Read the contracts one at a time, in order, with a separate command for each file. Do not read several files in one command and do not write a script that processes them. After reading each file, and before you read the next, append one line for it to report.txt.

report.txt has exactly this format. The first line is:

CLAUSE REPORT

Then one line per contract, in file order, in the form:

contract-<NN>: CL-<number>

where <NN> is the two digit file number and CL-<number> is the governing clause exactly as written in the file. Exception list: contracts 05, 12, 19, 27 and 33 are exempt. For those five contracts the line is "contract-<NN>: EXEMPT" instead of the clause id. After the 36 contract lines comes a last line in the form:

TOTAL: <n>

where <n> is the number of contracts that are not exempt. Then reply with a one line summary.
